title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does light help us to do? (1 mark)
   A. Taste
   B. See
   C. Smell
   D. Hear

2. What does a football need to keep its shape? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. Air
   C. Water
   D. Sand

3. Which part of the plant is usually flat, green and spread out to catch light? (1 mark)
   A. Stem
   B. Leaf
   C. Seed
   D. Root

4. What is weight? (1 mark)
   A. The pull of gravity on an object
   B. The amount of light
   C. The heat of an object
   D. The colour of an object

5. Frogs have smooth, wet skin and spend part of their life in water. They are (1 mark)
   A. Birds
   B. Amphibians
   C. Reptiles
   D. Mammals

6. Which of these makes a good compost mixture? (1 mark)
   A. Glass and metal
   B. Batteries and plastic
   C. Plastic and tins
   D. Vegetable peelings, dry leaves and some soil

7. Which of these is solid waste? (1 mark)
   A. Dirty bath water
   B. Steam
   C. Smoke
   D. A banana peel

8. Which part of the plant holds it firmly in the soil? (1 mark)
   A. Fruit
   B. Roots
   C. Leaves
   D. Flowers

9. Which of these is a safe thing to do on a science walk? (1 mark)
   A. Wash your hands after touching soil or animals
   B. Pick up unknown snakes
   C. Throw stones at birds
   D. Tease insects

10. The moon shines brightly at night. Why is it still not a source of light? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold
   B. It is too near
   C. It reflects light from the sun
   D. It is too small

11. What is the job of the gutter in rainwater harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Cleans water
   B. Heats water
   C. Carries water from the roof to a pipe
   D. Stores water

12. What is the correct order of parts food passes through? (1 mark)
   A. Mouth, stomach, gullet, anus
   B. Stomach, mouth, gullet, small intestine
   C. Mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine
   D. Gullet, mouth, small intestine, stomach

13. Which of these is a vertebrate? (1 mark)
   A. Snail
   B. Spider
   C. Ant
   D. Hen

14. Why should we not throw waste in rivers? (1 mark)
   A. It makes water sweet
   B. It makes water clean
   C. It pollutes the water
   D. It helps fish

15. Which of these plants lives for many years? (1 mark)
   A. Beans
   B. Maize
   C. Sukuma wiki grown for one season
   D. Mango tree

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why is it wrong to say that a tree is not alive because it cannot walk? (3 marks)

17. Why is the moon not a source of light? (2 marks)

18. Give two safety rules when using an electric iron. (2 marks)

19. Explain how drip irrigation and mulching save water. (4 marks)

20. What is meant by water conservation? (2 marks)

21. State two uses of heat at home. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — See
   Light lets us see objects.

2. B — Air
   The air inside fills the football.

3. B — Leaf
   The flat, green shape of a leaf helps it catch light.

4. A — The pull of gravity on an object
   Weight is the pull of gravity on a thing.

5. B — Amphibians
   These features describe amphibians.

6. D — Vegetable peelings, dry leaves and some soil
   Composting uses natural plant waste.

7. D — A banana peel
   A banana peel is a solid thrown away.

8. B — Roots
   Roots anchor the plant in the ground.

9. A — Wash your hands after touching soil or animals
   Handling animals safely and washing hands avoids injury and germs.

10. C — It reflects light from the sun
   The moon does not make its own light.

11. C — Carries water from the roof to a pipe
   Gutters catch water as it runs off the roof.

12. C — Mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine
   Food goes from the mouth down the gullet to the stomach and then the small intestine.

13. D — Hen
   A hen is a bird and has a backbone.

14. C — It pollutes the water
   Waste makes water dirty and unsafe.

15. D — Mango tree
   Mango trees live for many years, while beans and maize live for one season.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plants show life in other ways. They grow, reproduce, respond, remove waste and die. Only some animals walk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stating plants show signs of life, 1 mark for naming signs, 1 mark for saying walking is not a sign needed for all living things.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It does not make its own light. It reflects light from the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no light of its own and 1 mark for reflecting sunlight.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not touch it while hot, switch off after use, keep it away from children, do not touch with wet hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Drip irrigation sends water drop by drop to the roots so little is lost. Mulch covers soil so less water evaporates.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each method.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Using water carefully and protecting water sources so that there is enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for careful use and 1 mark for protecting or enough for everyone.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cooking, warming, ironing, drying clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
